mapper.sql: id, provider_id, provider_stop_id, parent_station_id, public_name, latitude, longitude, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transit_stop ( id, provider_id, provider_stop_id, parent_station_id, public_name, latitude, longitude, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{providerId}, #{providerStopId}, #{parentStationId}, #{publicName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (provider_id, provider_stop_id) DO UPDATE SET parent_station_id = EXCLUDED.parent_station_id, public_name = EXCLUDED.public_name, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: WITH ranked_stops AS ( SELECT rd.id AS "directionId", rd.display_name AS "directionName", ds.stop_id AS "stopId", ts.public_name AS "stopName", ds.stop_sequence AS "stopSequence", ts.latitude, ts.longitude, ds.next_stop_id AS "nextStopId", ds.display_direction AS "displayDirection", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rd.line_id, rd.display_name, ds.stop_id ORDER BY ds.stop_sequence, rd.provider_direction_id ) AS occurrence FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop ds ON ds.direction_id = rd.id INNER JOIN transit_stop ts ON ts.id = ds.stop_id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND rd.active = TRUE ) SELECT "directionId", "directionName", "stopId", "stopName", "stopSequence", latitude, longitude, "nextStopId", "displayDirection" FROM ranked_stops WHERE occurrence = 1 ORDER BY "directionName", "stopSequence" ASC

WITH boarding_position AS ( SELECT rd.id AS direction_id, MIN(boarding.stop_sequence) AS stop_sequence FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop boarding ON boarding.direction_id = rd.id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND boarding.stop_id = #{boardingStopId} AND rd.active = TRUE GROUP BY rd.id ), ranked_destinations AS ( SELECT rd.id AS "directionId", rd.display_name AS "directionName", destination.stop_id AS "stopId", destination_stop.public_name AS "stopName", destination.stop_sequence AS "stopSequence", destination.stop_sequence - boarding.stop_sequence AS "stopsAfterBoarding", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY destination.stop_id ORDER BY destination.stop_sequence - boarding.stop_sequence, rd.display_name, rd.id ) AS occurrence FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN boarding_position boarding ON boarding.direction_id = rd.id INNER JOIN directed_stop destination ON destination.direction_id = rd.id INNER JOIN transit_stop destination_stop ON destination_stop.id = destination.stop_id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND rd.active = TRUE AND destination.stop_sequence > boarding.stop_sequence AND destination.stop_id != #{boardingStopId} ) SELECT "directionId", "directionName", "stopId", "stopName", "stopSequence" FROM ranked_destinations WHERE occurrence = 1 ORDER BY "stopsAfterBoarding", "stopName" ASC

SELECT ts.id, ts.provider_id, ts.provider_stop_id, ts.parent_station_id, ts.public_name, ts.latitude, ts.longitude, ts.source_updated_at, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at FROM transit_stop ts WHERE ts.latitude BETWEEN #{minLatitude} AND #{maxLatitude} AND ts.longitude BETWEEN #{minLongitude} AND #{maxLongitude} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM directed_stop ds INNER JOIN route_direction rd ON rd.id = ds.direction_id AND rd.line_id = ds.line_id INNER JOIN transit_line tl ON tl.id = rd.line_id WHERE ds.stop_id = ts.id AND rd.active = TRUE AND tl.active = TRUE ) ORDER BY POWER(ts.latitude - #{centerLatitude}, 2) + POWER(ts.longitude - #{centerLongitude}, 2), ts.public_name, ts.id LIMIT #{limit}
